description.value: The West Fraser Centre is a municipal ice rink operated by the City of Quesnel in the Cariboo region of British Columbia. Situated along a key northern BC corridor, it serves as a community recreation facility that touring cyclists passing through Quesnel may encounter.

Without meaningful website content and with minimal OSM tags (no address, phone, or amenity tags), nearly all amenity fields must be null.
